fact: Senegal's government called in June 2026 for an individual DevOps consultant, financed by the World Bank PAENS project, to set up the software factory of Senegal Numerique SA and train its internal teams.
title: APPEL A CANDIDATURE Sélection d'un consultant individuel Devops pour la mise en place de l'usine logicielle de Sénégal numérique Sa
